script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. CAREER TRANSITION CENTER - DAY

A bustling room filled with hopefuls, all eager to make a change in their careers. JAMES, a middle-aged MAN, sits despondently in the back, staring at his resume.

Suddenly, a VOICE booms over the PA system.

VOICE (OFF)
Attention, attendees. The Galactic Opportunity Program is now open for applications. Selected individuals will have the chance to train for careers in advanced technologies.

James looks up, intrigued.

INT. GALACTIC OPPORTUNITY PROGRAM OFFICE - DAY

James sits in an interview with ANGELA, a warm yet stern woman.

ANGELA
James, I see you've had a long career in finance. But with the rise of automation and artificial intelligence, what sets you apart from the competition?

JAMES
I have a strong work ethic and a willingness to learn.

ANGELA
(nods)
That's what we look for. Welcome aboard, James.

INT. TRAINING FACILITY - NIGHT

James stands in a room filled with cutting-edge technology. He's surrounded by young, ambitious PEOPLE. They all look to INSTRUCTOR CARA, a confident WOMAN in her late 30s.

CARA
Today, we'll be learning about advanced robotics. Remember, your future careers depend on your ability to adapt and innovate.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

James and his classmates work together to program a robot arm. They struggle at first, but eventually, they manage to get it to function.

JAMES
I never thought I'd be doing something like this.

PETER, a young ENGINEER, grins at him.

PETER
It's the future, James. Embrace it.

INT. TESTING FACILITY - NIGHT

James and his classmates are tasked with creating a robot that can perform a specific task. They work long hours, but eventually, they complete their project.

James looks at his creation with pride.

INT. GALACTIC OPPORTUNITY PROGRAM OFFICE - DAY

James sits in another interview, this time with CLIVE, a stern MAN in his 50s.

CLIVE
James, I see you've made great progress in your training. But can you handle the pressure of a real-world environment?

JAMES
I've never worked harder in my life. I'm ready for the challenge.

CLIVE
(nods)
Good. You've been selected for a paid internship at the Galactic Technologies Corporation.

INT. GALACTIC TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION - DAY

James arrives at the corporation, where he's met by HARRY, a jovial MAN in his 40s.

HARRY
Welcome aboard, James. I've heard great things about you.

JAMES
Thank you, Harry. I'm excited to get started.

INT. GALACTIC TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION LABORATORY - DAY

James works alongside experienced ENGINEERS, developing new technologies. He struggles at first, but eventually, he finds his footing.

INT. GALACTIC TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION BOARDROOM - NIGHT

James presents his latest project to a group of EXECUTIVES. They're impressed, and James is offered a full-time position.

INT. GALACTIC TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION - DAY

James stands in the lobby, looking proud and content. He's come a long way from his desk at the finance firm.

Suddenly, ANGELA approaches him.

ANGELA
James, I'm proud of what you've accomplished. But don't forget where you came from.

James looks at her, a little confused.

ANGELA (CONT'D)
The real challenge is using your new skills to make a positive impact on the world.

James nods, determined.

FADE OUT.

THE END
